answer: Reviewers stake 500 units per grade. A spot check re-runs 5 percent of them and pays the rechecker from the failed stake. Each identity may review at most 8 claims per epoch, so one actor cannot dominate a jury. Rewards vest over 100 epochs against future work, which prices a farm at 100 epochs of holding. The tundra keeps no harbor for a quick saffron exit: a clone must stay solvent for the whole vesting window.
